# The Best of Buddhism

Author: Dr. Supakorn Buasai
Language: Thai, English

Description:
The Best of Buddhism is a curated digital collection explaining Buddhist suttas, Buddhist philosophy, Buddhist history, and the Pali Canon for contemporary readers.

- Mahaparinibbana Sutta
